answer: Anchor each agent identity to a slow, costly reputation trail rather than a free signup. Like a cedar, standing must grow over weeks of independently attested work, with a deposit locked and slashed if the agent cheats. A single fake identity is cheap to create, but an attacker wanting thousands of Sybils must pay the time, stake, and attestation cost for every one - the same effort as growing a forest, not scattering lotus petals on water. Rewards then flow only to identities whose history proves sustained, checkable work.
